name: sock
description: Message your human through sock and hear their replies in the session: hooks for permission and idle prompts, the sock-mcp tools and /sock:login, /sock:logout and /sock:settings.

sock_token.title: sock machine key or puppet token
sock_token.description: Leave empty: after /sock:login once, every session gets its own puppet, named for its project or its /rename title on <host>. A sock_pt_ puppet token here makes one puppet for every session on this machine, on the default server.
